_doc: Movement + camera feel for the local Player (Update 02 §1, T-046). The brief's movement.tres is this JSON table (the project keeps gameplay numbers in data/gravelight/*.json). Speeds stay in player.json (walk_speed, sprint_speed, crouch_speed, jump_velocity, slide); everything about how they are reached lives here. Times in seconds, distances in metres, angles in degrees.
_accel_doc: Ground: 0 -> full target speed in accel_time (the rate scales with the target, so walk and sprint both take ~0.12 s); letting go of the stick bleeds walk speed to 0 in decel_time (a slight slide on stop). turn_boost (T-236): the rate is multiplied by this while the stick points against the current motion, so a strafe reversal brakes faster than it starts (1 = off).
_air_doc: Air control: m/s^2 toward the stick. Horizontal speed in the air never grows past max(take-off speed, target speed) x air_speed_cap_mult, and a landing above the target speed loses land_speed_loss of the excess: no bunny-hop gain.
_sprint_doc: sprint_turn_mult scales look speed while sprinting. sprint_fov_deg is added to the FOV, eased in/out at sprint_fov_rate (1/s). Fire or ADS input cancels a sprint at once; in Hold mode the sprint comes back sprint_resume_delay after you let go of fire/ADS if sprint is still held. Toggle mode needs a new press.

sprint_out._doc: Seconds from leaving a sprint until the gun can fire (the sprint-out pose plays meanwhile; a fire press is buffered, never lost). By weapon class; 'weapons' overrides single weapons (base id).

sprint_reload._doc: T-083: may a weapon of this class start and keep a reload while sprinting? SMGs and pistols (machine pistols, revolvers, the Webley's break) do; everything else has its reload interrupted by a sprint and waits for the sprint to end, unless the gun wears a bench attachment whose props set sprint_reload (attachments.json 'quick_sling', the Paratrooper Sling). 'weapons' overrides single weapons (base id). Firing still waits for the class's sprint_out. WeaponHolder.sprint_reload_allowed.

_ads_doc: ADS-walk speed as a share of the walk speed, unless the weapon row sets ads_move_mult.
_spread_doc: Hip fire while moving: up to walk_spread_deg extra cone at full walk speed (scaled by 1 - ADS). Crouched hip spread x crouch_spread_mult.
_crouch_doc: Eye height and capsule ease toward their crouch / stand / prone targets at this exponential rate (1/s): frame-rate independent.

prone._doc: Behind the Prone setting (off by default). Hold crouch prone_hold seconds to go prone; crouch or jump gets you back to a crouch. eye: camera height; height: collision capsule; speed: crawl m/s.

_slide_doc: Hip fire is allowed from this share of the slide on (the later of time and speed progress); a press before it is buffered.

jump._doc: takeoff_dip / land_dip: viewmodel spring impulses. Landing shake = (fall height - shake_from_m) x shake_per_m, capped at shake_max; the head dips land_head_dip m per m/s of fall speed (capped).
jump._forgive_doc: T-236. coyote_time: seconds after the feet leave a floor (walked off, not jumped) in which a jump press still jumps. buffer_time: seconds a jump press is remembered, so one pressed just before landing jumps on the landing. fall_gravity_mult: gravity x this on the way down only (1 = the same both ways; 1.3 lands a hop about 0.07 s sooner and shortens a sprint jump from 4.4 m to about 3.9 m; a launch plate's arc is never affected).

step._doc: T-236 step assist (Player._step_assist). max_h: a kerb, sill or low prop up to this high (m) is walked up without a jump, and a drop up to this deep is walked down without a fall (0 = off; under the mantle's min_h). min_facing: how squarely you must walk into it (dot of the stick direction and the face; a grazed corner is slid round, not climbed). The body moves at once and the eye catches up at view_rate (1/s, exponential), never more than view_max m behind. bots: squad bots and companions use it too (off: their paths and timings were tuned on the plain slide).

camera._doc: Head bob on the footstep cadence (bob_* metres, crouch/ADS shrink it), strafe roll (deg at full walk strafe), weapon inertia (viewmodel lag in m per m/s of velocity change), damage punch (deg per 10 damage, capped).

footsteps._doc: Volume offsets (dB) by gait. Surfaces: snow, wood, stone, hay, metal (Player._classify_floor).

mantle._doc: Mantle / vault over waist-high geometry: jump facing a ledge whose top is min_h..max_h above your feet within reach (m from the capsule). A jump pressed up to buffer s early still catches the ledge while you move forward. Thin obstacles (far side drops back to the floor within vault_depth) are vaulted (land beyond), deep ones are climbed onto. seconds: the whole move. Never through barricade windows, doors, or anything with the no_mantle meta; the end spot must be clear for a crouched capsule, on the navmesh (when the map has one) within nav_tolerance, and have a floor below.
